fact: The World Bank's primary health care assessment of July 2023 states that The Gambia uses its HMIS to collect and store data in DHIS2 across all public facilities, that paper-based data collection continues in many lower-level facilities, and that private and urban facilities are excluded from the HMIS; it adds that the country has no unique person identification allowing facilities to keep longitudinal personal care records.
title: The Primary Health Care System of The Gambia: A Primary Health Care Performance Initiative Assessment
